about: Version 4 of Jev as judge: the five dimension scores of the eval judge, each from small questions about the tool's rubric (a Score with levels described as situations, a Noul, or a check in code). Code averages the parts per dimension on 0 to 1 and maps that to 1 to 5. Written before any Jev answer on these outputs was seen; tuned only on the tuning set, against Bastiaan's own labels. See evals/judge-jev/README.md, 'Versie 4'.
